coverage.notes: The NYU Shanghai undergraduate site and 2026-27 NYU Bulletin enumerate 19 majors. Students enter a shared four-year, English-medium liberal-arts curriculum, normally choose a major after broad core studies, and apply to NYU Shanghai rather than to any one of the 19 majors. Consequently this catalogue-mode return documents four contrasting representative majors and all three academically designated divisions; it is NOT a full 2027 programme inventory. The NYU Shanghai majors page and NYU 2026-27 undergraduate bulletin are the full catalogue handoff. Published 2026-27 programmes do not independently prove that each major will run without alteration in fall 2027.

institution.summary: NYU and East China Normal University joint research university in Shanghai; four-year, English-taught NYU BA/BS with a Chinese diploma.

programmes.name: Data Science
programmes.credential: New York University Bachelor of Science (BS) and a separate Chinese-accredited NYU Shanghai diploma
programmes.campus: New Bund Campus, Qiantan, Pudong, Shanghai, China
programmes.language: English (non-Chinese students also must learn Mandarin Chinese)
programmes.about: Mathematics, statistics and computing for analysing large datasets, with concentrations ranging from finance and AI to genomics.
programmes.overview: Students build foundations in programming, probability, statistics, calculus, linear algebra and algorithms before studying machine learning, database systems and the analysis of diverse kinds of data. The curriculum allows a concentration such as artificial intelligence, finance, genomics, economics or psychology, while maintaining the university-wide liberal arts core. Work culminates in an advanced project or senior capstone linking methods to a problem in a chosen field. The bulletin describes preparation for data-focused roles or further study across technical and other disciplines.

programmes.name: Business and Finance
programmes.credential: New York University Bachelor of Science (BS) and a separate Chinese-accredited NYU Shanghai diploma
programmes.campus: New Bund Campus, Qiantan, Pudong, Shanghai, China
programmes.language: English (non-Chinese students also must learn Mandarin Chinese)
programmes.about: Business education integrating economics, statistics, accounting and management with a focus on financial markets and investment.
programmes.overview: This major builds on NYU Shanghai’s liberal arts core, with emphasis on quantitative reasoning, economic analysis and written and spoken communication. Students study the workings of organisations through economics, statistics, accounting, marketing, operations and management, then concentrate more closely on finance. The programme addresses corporate finance, investment management, securities trading and financial markets, linking financial decisions to their wider business context. Its curriculum includes a senior research or thesis component and aims to prepare students for business-related work or advanced study.

programmes.name: Interactive Media Arts
programmes.credential: New York University Bachelor of Science (BS) and a separate Chinese-accredited NYU Shanghai diploma
programmes.campus: New Bund Campus, Qiantan, Pudong, Shanghai, China
programmes.language: English (non-Chinese students also must learn Mandarin Chinese)
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary media-arts major combining theory, digital technologies, creative coding, design and project-based making.
programmes.overview: Students first consider the history and theory of emerging media through a required new-media foundation course. They then explore interaction design, physical computing, digital fabrication, media design or creative coding, with elective work across art, humanities, science and computing. Advanced labs and seminars develop technical practice alongside critical and artistic inquiry. In the final two semesters, a Capstone Studio project combines an original media work with a related research essay. The university-wide core remains part of the degree.

programmes.name: Neural Science
programmes.credential: New York University Bachelor of Science (BS) and a separate Chinese-accredited NYU Shanghai diploma
programmes.campus: New Bund Campus, Qiantan, Pudong, Shanghai, China
programmes.language: English (non-Chinese students also must learn Mandarin Chinese)
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary investigation of the brain, from nerve cells and circuits to cognition and behaviour, using experimental and computational approaches.
programmes.overview: Students begin with foundations in biology, chemistry, physics and mathematics before moving into advanced neural science. The field is approached through molecular and cellular mechanisms, neural circuits, behaviour, cognition and mathematical or computational models of brain function. Required courses and electives culminate in a capstone, allowing students to connect evidence and methods across levels of analysis. The programme also describes a research-oriented honours pathway for eligible students, separate from initial undergraduate admission.

faculties.name: Arts and Sciences
faculties.guidance: The undergraduate academic division that houses science, humanities, economics, social science, neural science and interactive media majors. Entry is to NYU Shanghai as a whole; the shared core precedes major selection.

faculties.name: Business
faculties.guidance: The undergraduate academic division covering Business and Finance and Business and Marketing. It is not a distinct first-year Common Application route; students normally select their major after foundational study.

faculties.name: Engineering and Computer Science
faculties.guidance: The official Chinese-language majors directory groups computer science, computer systems engineering, data science and electrical and systems engineering here. The main English site calls this area Computer Science, Data Science, and Engineering; entry follows the common NYU Shanghai route.
